title: dryopteris parasitica
intro: Dryopteris parasitica, commonly known as the eastern wood fern, is a species of fern that belongs to the family Dryopteridaceae. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as reducing inflammation, improving respiratory issues, and acting as an antiseptic. The therapeutic actions of Dryopteris parasitica include its antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant properties, making it a potential treatment for various conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
